method.contact: Integrate penalty/dashpot traction only over exposed spherical surface below ground; no whole-ball force on covered ball bottoms.
method.boundary_unknown: For each spherical cap, u_b(n)=site_velocity+radius_rate*n. This same velocity supplies geometry, gradient and work.
method.boundary_equation: Integral B^T [sigma*n + Z*(B*a-v) - t(B*a)] dA = 0; B=[I,n]. Four local unknowns, translation-only on nearly flat caps.
method.friction: Viscously regularized Coulomb, not exact static sticking; tangential work returned as heat. Compliant normal contact exchanges energy with obstacle.
method.quadrature: Exact exposed-arc topology followed by finite-order Gauss integration. GPU batching preserves reference points and weights.
method.agglomeration: Adjacent geometric cells share one piecewise-constant conservative FV state. Sum group volume, flux and gradient integrals; internal face contributions cancel. Redistribute extensive channels by current geometric volume.
method.merge_selection: Small group volume <0.001 initial median, or wave-based physical stable step <1e-6 s; merge with neighbor sharing largest total wall area; at most 32 members.
method.merge_geometry: No sites, radii or surface patches removed at merging. Grouped interior subcells may become hidden with zero volume while group volume/state remains valid.
method.coarsening: Local relative deformation is lost; preserving the boundary at merge time does NOT establish unchanged future motion or accuracy.

limitations: This is an experimental sphere-cap adaptation of FV ideas, not a reproduction of a published complete solid ALE solver.
Hypoelastic/Jaumann plastic model and stiffened-gas EOS differ from k1; matching initial moduli does not establish material equivalence.
Global total-energy source balance is not a constitutive free-energy or entropy proof.
Groups persist; splitting, connectivity changes and long-run resolution have not been validated.
Normal penalty contact allows penetration. Boundary acoustic relation is enforced weakly, not pointwise.
No exact finite-step geometric conservation proof, mesh/time convergence, final MPM comparison or production-speed claim.
This successful-run chain, if completed, introduces grouping at t=0.2039607747661155; it is not a fresh t=0 run with grouping enabled throughout.
